import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-allocation-origin-path').read_text().strip())
label = sys.argv[1]
assert not (root / (label + '.json')).exists(), label
command = sys.argv[2:]
source = root / 'source'

def hashes():
    return {str(p.relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()
            and (p.suffix == '.rs' or p.name in ('Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'))}

before = hashes()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(root / 'target')
env['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS'] = '2'
start = time.time()
with (root / (label + '.stdout')).open('w') as out, (root / (label + '.stderr')).open('w') as err:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command}), flush=True)
    code = process.wait()
after = hashes()
record = {'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command,
          'source_revision': json.loads((root / 'setup.json').read_text())['source_revision'],
          'returncode': code, 'seconds': time.time() - start,
          'source_hashes_before': before, 'source_hashes_after': after,
          'source_unchanged_during_run': before == after,
          'stdout': (root / (label + '.stdout')).read_text(),
          'stderr': (root / (label + '.stderr')).read_text()}
(root / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
assert before == after, 'source mutated while work live'
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('label', 'pid', 'returncode', 'seconds', 'source_unchanged_during_run')}))
print(record['stdout'][-5000:])
print(record['stderr'][-2000:])
sys.exit(code)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-allocation-origin-path').read_text().strip())
setup = json.loads((root / 'setup.json').read_text())
source = root / 'source'
binary = root / 'baseline-tsr'
if not binary.exists():
    subprocess.run(['cp', '-c', str(root / 'target/release/tsr'), str(binary)], check=True)

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

perf = load('perf', source / 'scripts/whole_project_perf.py')
sample = load('samples', source / 'docs/architecture/current-project-cost-controls.py')
project = Path('<private-nextjs>/tsconfig.json')
assert project.is_file()
for name in list(os.environ):
    if name.startswith('TSR_'):
        os.environ.pop(name)
os.environ['TSR_LIB_PATH'] = str(source / 'vendor/typescript-go/internal/bundled/libs')
flags = ['--project', str(project), '--noEmit', '--incremental', 'false',
         '--composite', 'false', '--pretty', 'false']
state = {'source': setup['source_revision'], 'native': setup['native_revision'],
         'binary_sha256': perf.inputs.file_hash(binary), 'project': str(project),
         'runs': [], 'complete': False, 'actual_checked_identity_verified': False,
         'complete_input_coverage_verified': False, 'native_speed_verified': False}

def save():
    (root / 'baseline.json').write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')

if (root / 'baseline.json').exists():
    previous = json.loads((root / 'baseline.json').read_text())
    assert previous['source'] == state['source'] and previous['binary_sha256'] == state['binary_sha256']
    state = previous
    state.setdefault('driver_history', []).append('Resume after failed sampler returned nonzero and no sample file. First failed sample child metadata was not persisted by the original driver; it is excluded from qualified evidence. Completed listing/default-normal retained. New driver persists raw sample result before parsing.')
    listing = state['listing']
else:
    listing = perf.process([str(binary), *flags, '--listFilesOnly'], project.parent, 180)
    (root / 'listing.stdout').write_text(listing['stdout'])
    (root / 'listing.stderr').write_text(listing['stderr'])
assert listing['exit_code'] == 0 and not listing['timed_out']
loaded = listing['stdout'].splitlines()
assert loaded and all(Path(name).is_file() for name in loaded)
old = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-cost-refresh-path').read_text().strip())
paths, provenance = perf.inputs.load_manifest(old / 'inputs.json', project.parent)
paths = sorted(set(paths + loaded + [str(project), str(binary)]))
reference = perf.inputs.snapshot(paths)
assert perf.inputs.valid_snapshot(reference)
if state.get('input_fingerprint'):
    assert state['input_fingerprint'] == perf.fingerprint(reference), 'inputs changed at resume'
state.update(loaded_count=len(loaded), loaded_order_sha256=perf.fingerprint(loaded),
             input_fingerprint=perf.fingerprint(reference), query_input_provenance=provenance,
             listing=listing)
(root / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(reference, indent=2) + '\n')
save()
expected = {row['mode']: (row['stdout'], row['stderr'], row['exit_code']) for row in state['runs']}
for mode in ['default', 'single']:
    mode_flags = flags + ([] if mode == 'default' else ['--singleThreaded', 'true'])
    for label, delay in [('normal', None), ('early', .2), ('late', 2.5)]:
        if any(row['mode'] == mode and row['label'] == label for row in state['runs']):
            continue
        assert perf.inputs.snapshot(paths) == reference
        command = [str(binary), *mode_flags, '--listFiles']
        print(json.dumps({'starting': mode + '-' + label, 'command': command}), flush=True)
        if delay is None:
            row = perf.process(command, project.parent, 180)
        else:
            report = root / (mode + '-' + label + '.sample')
            row = sample.profiled_process(command, project.parent, report, delay, 3, 180)
            (root / (mode + '-' + label + '.raw.json')).write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2) + '\n')
            assert row['sample_exit'] == 0
            row['samples'] = sample.parse_thread_samples(report.read_text())
        row.update(mode=mode, label=label)
        assert not row['timed_out'] and row['exit_code'] in (0, 1, 2)
        streams = (row['stdout'], row['stderr'], row['exit_code'])
        if mode not in expected:
            expected[mode] = streams
        assert streams == expected[mode], 'sampled output changed'
        assert perf.inputs.snapshot(paths) == reference
        row['diagnostics'] = perf.diagnostics(row['stdout'], project.parent)
        for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
            (root / (mode + '-' + label + '.' + stream)).write_text(row[stream])
        state['runs'].append(row)
        save()
        print(json.dumps({'completed': mode + '-' + label, 'wall': row['wall_seconds'],
                          'diagnostics': row['diagnostics']['count']}), flush=True)
assert expected['default'] == expected['single'], 'worker-mode outputs differ'
state['complete'] = True
save()
print(json.dumps({'complete': True, 'loaded': len(loaded), 'runs': len(state['runs'])}))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-allocation-origin-path').read_text().strip())
source = root / 'source'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('perf', source / 'scripts/whole_project_perf.py')
perf = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(perf)
probe = root / 'probe-tsr'
if not probe.exists():
    subprocess.run(['cp', '-c', str(root / 'target/release/tsr'), str(probe)], check=True)
normal = root / 'baseline-tsr'
for key in list(os.environ):
    if key.startswith('TSR_'):
        os.environ.pop(key)
os.environ['TSR_LIB_PATH'] = str(source / 'vendor/typescript-go/internal/bundled/libs')
baseline = json.loads((root / 'baseline.json').read_text())
assert baseline['complete']
observed_paths = [row['path'] for row in json.loads((root / 'inputs.json').read_text())]
reference = perf.inputs.snapshot(observed_paths)
assert perf.fingerprint(reference) == baseline['input_fingerprint']
source_hashes = {str(p.relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                 for p in source.rglob('*') if p.is_file()
                 and (p.suffix == '.rs' or p.name in ['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock'])}
fixtures = {
    'generic': 'interface Box<T> { value: T }; declare const a: Box<string>; const wrong: number = a.value;',
    'mapped': 'type Model = { value: string; count: number }; declare const a: Readonly<Partial<Model>>; const wrong: boolean = a.value;',
    'receiver': 'interface Base<T> { self(): this; value: T }; interface Derived<U> extends Base<U> { own: U }; declare const a: Derived<string>; const good: Derived<string> = a.self(); const wrong: number = a.value;',
    'cycle': 'import { B } from "./b"; export interface A<T> { b: B<T>; value: T }; declare const a: A<string>; const wrong: number = a.b.a.value;',
}
projects = []
for name, text in fixtures.items():
    folder = root / 'fixtures' / name
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / 'input.ts').write_text(text + '\n')
    files = ['input.ts']
    if name == 'cycle':
        (folder / 'b.ts').write_text('import { A } from "./input"; export interface B<T> { a: A<T> }\n')
        files.append('b.ts')
    (folder / 'tsconfig.json').write_text(json.dumps({'compilerOptions': {
        'target': 'es2020', 'module': 'esnext', 'strict': True, 'types': [],
        'noEmit': True, 'skipLibCheck': True, 'incremental': False, 'composite': False},
        'files': files}, indent=2) + '\n')
    projects.append((name, folder / 'tsconfig.json'))
projects.append(('nextjs', Path(baseline['project'])))
state = {'source': baseline['source'], 'probe_source_hashes': source_hashes,
         'binary_sha256': {'normal': perf.inputs.file_hash(normal), 'probe': perf.inputs.file_hash(probe)},
         'runs': [], 'complete': False, 'input_coverage': 'loaded plus historical observed queries, partial',
         'actual_checked_identity_verified': False, 'native_work_verified': False,
         'native_target_verified': False}

def save():
    (root / 'controls.json').write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')

def origin_rows(stderr):
    rows = []
    total = None
    remaining = []
    for line in stderr.splitlines(keepends=True):
        fields = line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        if fields[0] == 'ORIGIN':
            assert len(fields) == 10
            values = list(map(int, fields[3:]))
            rows.append(dict(zip(['id', 'name', 'entries', 'allocations', 'reallocations',
                                  'requested_bytes', 'live_requested_bytes', 'peak_requested_bytes',
                                  'live_padded_bytes'], [int(fields[1]), fields[2], *values])))
        elif fields[0] == 'ORIGIN_TOTAL':
            assert len(fields) == 4 and total is None
            total = dict(zip(['live_requested_bytes', 'peak_requested_bytes', 'live_padded_bytes'], map(int, fields[1:])))
        else:
            remaining.append(line)
    if rows:
        assert sorted(row['id'] for row in rows) == list(range(1, 7)) and total is not None
        assert sum(row['live_requested_bytes'] for row in rows) == total['live_requested_bytes']
        assert sum(row['live_padded_bytes'] for row in rows) == total['live_padded_bytes']
    return rows, total, ''.join(remaining)

save()
for name, project in projects:
    for mode in ['default', 'single']:
        flags = ['--project', str(project), '--noEmit', '--incremental', 'false',
                 '--composite', 'false', '--pretty', 'false', '--listFiles']
        if mode == 'single':
            flags += ['--singleThreaded', 'true']
        expected = None
        if name == 'nextjs':
            prior = next(row for row in baseline['runs'] if row['mode'] == mode and row['label'] == 'normal')
            expected = (prior['stdout'], prior['stderr'], prior['exit_code'])
        for variant in ['normal', 'off', 'on', 'repeat']:
            assert perf.inputs.snapshot(observed_paths) == reference
            assert all(hashlib.sha256((source / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == h for p, h in source_hashes.items())
            enabled = variant in ['on', 'repeat']
            if enabled:
                os.environ['TSR_ALLOCATION_ORIGIN_PROBE'] = '1'
            else:
                os.environ.pop('TSR_ALLOCATION_ORIGIN_PROBE', None)
            binary = normal if variant == 'normal' else probe
            print(json.dumps({'starting': name, 'mode': mode, 'variant': variant}), flush=True)
            row = perf.process([str(binary), *flags], project.parent, 180)
            row.update(project=name, mode=mode, variant=variant, probe_enabled=enabled)
            state['runs'].append(row)
            save()
            assert not row['timed_out'] and row['exit_code'] in [0, 1, 2]
            origins, total, filtered = origin_rows(row['stderr'])
            assert bool(origins) == enabled
            streams = (row['stdout'], filtered, row['exit_code'])
            if expected is None:
                expected = streams
            assert streams == expected, 'ordinary diagnostic/loaded/exit payload changed'
            row.update(origins=origins, total=total, output_matches_baseline=True,
                       diagnostics=perf.diagnostics(row['stdout'], project.parent))
            assert perf.inputs.snapshot(observed_paths) == reference
            assert perf.inputs.file_hash(normal) == state['binary_sha256']['normal']
            assert perf.inputs.file_hash(probe) == state['binary_sha256']['probe']
            save()
            print(json.dumps({'completed': name, 'mode': mode, 'variant': variant,
                              'wall': row['wall_seconds'], 'origins': origins if enabled else []}), flush=True)
state['complete'] = True
save()
